rawFindings.title: Nested typed values with null payload no longer encode as null
rawFindings.explanation: After this change, `writeObject()` only special-cases a top-level `null` object. For a property value like `{ $class: 'java.lang.Long', $: null }`, the encoder now falls through to `_writeObject()` and writes an object wrapper instead of the required Hessian `N` null token.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the null-payload check for typed values and return `writeNull()` when `obj.$class` is a string and `obj.$` is null/undefined.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: `hessian.encode({ $class: 'xxx.xxx', $: { a: { $class: 'yyy.yyy', $: null } } }, '1.0')` now emits an encoded object for `a` instead of `...530001614e7a`, so the decoder sees an empty object/typed object instead of `null`.
